Subject: POC plan and success criteria  FinCore

Hi Alex  great to meet today. Thanks again for taking the time to walk through FinCore's goals for the model-powered assistant. Recap from our call and proposed next steps for the 4-week POC: 

Summary / success criteria (please confirm):
- Functional: LLM-powered assistant answers for underwriting workflows with >= 85% accuracy on the provided eval set.
- Performance: P95 latency < 300ms for representative prompts (avg length ~150 tokens) at target query rate (~10 qps).
- Cost: Token cost target < $X per 1M tokens (we'll provide a projection once we finalize prompt mix).
- Security/compliance: POC runs in our dedicated trial instance; data retention set to 30 days; audit logs enabled.

POC scope & evaluation plan:
- Week 0 (prep, by Jun 14): your team provides a sandbox dataset (sample transcripts + labels) and a list of top 20 prompts/use cases.
- Week 1 (kickoff Jun 17): Redwood provides a staging instance, test API key, sample integration snippets, and initial prompt templates.
- Weeks 2-3: integration + run evaluation harness; we provide dashboards and test harness (bleu/accuracy/latency).
- Week 4: joint review, run-through of success criteria, handoff conversation and optional next-step pricing/production plan.

Ownership (proposed):
- FinCore: Alex Johnson (sponsor), Emily Park (eng lead  provides dataset & sets up integration contacts).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM), Marcus Lin (technical lead), Dev Patel (onboarding/ops).

Action items (please confirm who will own):
1) FinCore to share sandbox dataset + sample prompts by Jun 14 (sftp or Drive link).
2) Redwood to provide staging endpoint + test credentials by Jun 16.
3) Schedule kickoff working session Jun 17 (30-60 min).
4) Agree on evaluation harness metrics and pass/fail thresholds (we can add these to the SOW).

I'm attaching a draft SOW and the onboarding checklist to make the tech setup as frictionless as possible. If the timeline looks good, I'll schedule the kickoff slot for Jun 17 at 10am PT.

Thanks  looking forward.


